import sqlite3

# Connect to the SQLite database
db_path = "./dacomp-085.sqlite"
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Get the global sum of career_development_score
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(career_development_score) FROM workday__employee_overview;")
global_sum = cursor.fetchone()[0]

print(f"Global SUM: {global_sum}")

# Get compensation_grade_id groups ordered by population (count) descending
cursor.execute("""
    SELECT compensation_grade_id, COUNT(*) as population, SUM(career_development_score) as group_sum
    FROM workday__employee_overview
    GROUP BY compensation_grade_id
    ORDER BY population DESC;
""")
grade_groups = cursor.fetchall()

# Calculate running totals
running_total = global_sum
running_totals = [global_sum]
group_sums = []

print("\nRunning totals after progressive exclusions:")

# First show the starting point (before any exclusions)
print(f"Step 0 (all data): {running_total}")

# For each group, subtract its sum and report running total
for i, (grade_id, population, group_sum) in enumerate(grade_groups, 1):
    running_total -= group_sum
    running_totals.append(running_total)
    group_sums.append(group_sum)
    
    print(f"Step {i}: {running_total}")

print("\nPer-group career_development_score totals (implicitly computed):")
for i, group_sum in enumerate(group_sums, 1):
    print(f"Group {i}: {group_sum}")

cursor.close()
conn.close()
